body.description: Pixel-art diorama: an intimate lived-in refuge at a dungeon entrance. Broad connected color clusters, compact heroic silhouettes, matte planes, crisp stepped edges, quiet shadow masses and selective details. 8-12 varied mercenaries talk in pairs, share bowls and mend equipment, amid bedrolls, patched cloth and sacks. Exactly ONE small mage stands apart, STRICTLY BACK TO CAMERA, entirely in deep architectural shadow. Opaque black hood and cloak conceal face, skin, hands, hair, age and gender; no rim light. Nobody notices, looks toward or reacts to the mage. Social warmth belongs to others; the mage is excluded from their connections. No war, army, battlefield, ruined city, monsters, epic scale, magic glow, grain, dithering, text, icons or HUD. PLACE: One cropped stone bridge diagonally crosses a small cavern stream. Its thick pier divides a crowded dry storage alcove from a narrow unlit stair for the mage. A low culvert descends into the dungeon. COMPOSITION: Look lengthwise under the bridge through two overlapping dark arches; people occupy the middle depth. COLOR SCRIPT: ash gray, near-black aubergine shadows, oxblood fabric, low warm lamps. Restrained saturation, a legible dark mage silhouette. One complete scene with a quiet dark surrounding field, no decorative frame.
